title: compar:IA: The French Government’s LLM arena to collect French-language human prompts and preference data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs through a blind pairwise comparison arena (compar:IA) using crowdsourced human preference votes from a predominantly French-speaking audience to counteract the English-centric dominance in pre-training and alignment data.
Capturing unconstrained, real-world prompts and user judgments to assess models' cultural alignment, register, and appropriateness in a non-English (specifically French) context.

Identifying inherent human evaluator biases in pairwise preference data, such as preferences for longer responses (verbosity), specific formatting, emojis, latency, and sycophancy, which can skew model alignment and perceived quality.
